entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-10
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Perf improvement: ApiCrudListProducts #62667
  • Perf improvement: json_middleware #62666
  • Consider allowing a custom JwtBearerHandler implementation in AddJwtBearer #62658
  • `GetValidationAttributes` needs updated DAM attributes in Validations source generator #62655
  • Evaluate ServiceKeyLookupMode usage in Blazor #62654
    10.0-rc1
  • Be able to switch off Actions, Diagnostics and Metrics #62651
  • Obsolete Razor Runtime Compilation (Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Razor.RuntimeCompilation) #62648

Closed

  • Blazor quickgrid error - The supplied expression can't be represented as a property name for sorting #62582
    Backlog
  • Blazor SSR implementation of Fortunes benchmark is considerably slower than Razor Pages implementation #54232
    10.0-rc1
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `aspnetcore/release/8.0` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #62621
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `aspnetcore/release/9.0` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #62620
  • [Blazor] Avoid creating a cache dictionary per instance on PersistentStateValueProvider #62659
  • Reduce error level of `blazor.web.js` does not exist errors #57149
    .NET 10 Planning
  • Add an InputHidden component for Blazor #55720
    Backlog
  • Better diagnostics/information for circular DI dependencies in Blazor WebAssembly #43866
    Backlog
  • Unhandled exceptions are being logged before custom IExceptionHandler is being called #54554
    9.0.0
  • Record metrics for user account activities #52996
    Backlog

    Attention: Shared Code Modified

    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, build-ops

    area-blazor, community-contribution

    area-infrastructure, 10.0-preview7

    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, build-ops, 10.0-preview7

    area-blazor, 10.0-preview7
